clue.text: Cause followed by friend from time to time

parts.note: to cause something is to occasion it
an ally is a friend or supporter

explanation.surface: Someone takes up a cause and is joined now and then by a friend.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: an adverb meaning at irregular intervals, now and then.

clue.text: Removing son during pleasure trip

indicators.note: the son letter sits during, i.e. within, the trip word

parts.note: an outing is a pleasure trip

explanation.surface: A boy is taken away in the middle of a day out.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: expelling or ejecting someone is removing them from a place or post.

clue.text: Firm retaining worker to produce a bit of poetry

indicators.note: the firm's abbreviation holds on to the worker, keeping it inside

parts.note: CO is the abbreviation for company, a firm
a worker ant is the crossword's usual worker

explanation.surface: A company keeps on an employee so that verse gets written.
explanation.definitionFit: A canto is a main division of a long poem, such as those of Dante's Divine Comedy.

clue.text: Marine worrying as if angler will lose line

indicators.note: worrying at something works it over and disturbs it, so the letters are rearranged
signals that a letter is dropped from the fodder

explanation.surface: A sea creature frets that it looks like a fisherman about to have his line snap.
explanation.walkthrough: 'will lose' takes L from AS IF ANGLER, leaving ASIFANGER, which 'worrying' rearranges.
explanation.definitionFit: Adjective synonym: both describe things relating to the sea and voyaging on it.

clue.text: State loves welcoming greeting

indicators.note: welcoming means taking a guest in, so the greeting goes inside

parts.note: love is zero in tennis, written O; two loves give two Os
hi is an informal greeting

explanation.surface: A US state that adores hospitality and saying hello.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: one of the fifty United States, in the Midwest.

clue.text: Sort of plant for a dreamer with no name?

indicators.note: signals that the name letter is taken away

parts.note: a romantic is an idealistic dreamer

explanation.surface: A puzzle over which plant would suit an anonymous idealist.
explanation.walkthrough: Herbs such as basil or mint are classed as aromatic plants, which makes 'sort of plant' fair for the adjective.
explanation.definitionFit: A descriptive class: fragrant herbs and shrubs are called aromatic plants.

clue.text: Improving after circuit, getting to drink eagerly

indicators.note: the improving word is placed after the circuit word

parts.note: a lap is one circuit of a track
things that are up are on the rise or improving

explanation.surface: A runner gets better after each lap and then gulps a drink.
explanation.definitionFit: Phrasal verb: to lap up is to drink greedily, as a cat does milk.

clue.text: Footballer perhaps must cover shot for lover of drama

indicators.note: the footballer word covers, i.e. encloses, the shot word

parts.note: a footballer is an example of a player
to have a go is to have a shot or try

explanation.surface: A footballer has to take a shot to impress a fan.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: someone who regularly attends the theatre loves plays.

clue.text: Decline, missing a second order

indicators.note: missing tells us letters are absent from the decline word

parts.note: a decrease is a decline

explanation.surface: Turning something down without a second order sounds like official business.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: an edict or official command issued by an authority.

clue.text: Sweden anticipates new Romanian republic

indicators.note: anticipates means comes before, so Sweden's letter leads

parts.note: S is the international vehicle code for Sweden

indicators.note: new suggests a fresh form of the word, an anagram

explanation.surface: Sweden foresees a fresh Romanian state being formed.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a tiny independent republic enclosed by Italy.

clue.text: It should beat a runner, for example

definitions.meaning: the regular throb of the heart, which ought to keep beating
a runner bean is an edible seed of the legume family

explanation.surface: Something should outrun an athlete, perhaps.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Runner' looks like an athlete but is the runner bean, a legume.
explanation.definitionFit: The rhythm felt in the arteries, and also edible legume seeds such as beans and lentils.

clue.text: Pressure line like this found in one pub

indicators.note: the like-this word is found inside the others

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one
a bar is a pub
so means in this way, like this

explanation.surface: A weather line of this sort turns up in a pub.
explanation.definitionFit: On a weather map, a line joining points of equal atmospheric pressure.

clue.text: Government supporter wielding party axe?

indicators.note: wielding an axe swings it around, so the letters are thrown about

explanation.surface: A politician's backer swinging the party axe over spending cuts.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Government supporter' is witty: one who pays tax literally funds the state.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who pays levies funds, and so supports, the state financially.

clue.text: Tactic doctor employed during walk

indicators.note: the doctor is used in the middle of the walk word

parts.note: a gait is a manner of walking
MB, Bachelor of Medicine, is a doctor's qualification

explanation.surface: A medic adopts a clever ploy while out on a stroll.
explanation.definitionFit: A gambit is an opening move or ploy calculated to gain an advantage, as in chess.

clue.text: Terminals planned with no area for an entertainer

indicators.note: planned means laid out afresh, so the letters are rearranged
signals that the area letter is dropped from the fodder

explanation.surface: Transport terminals designed without space for a performer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'with no' removes A from TERMINALS, leaving TERMINLS for 'planned' to rearrange.
explanation.definitionFit: A medieval singer or musician, a travelling performer of songs and verse.

clue.text: Fail to get on record broadcast

indicators.note: on means placed after, so the fail word follows the record

parts.note: a disc is a record
to lose is to fail to obtain or win

explanation.surface: Not managing to get a song onto a record that is played on air.
explanation.walkthrough: 'broadcast' looks like radio, but here means spread news about, i.e. make known.
explanation.definitionFit: Verb synonym: to broadcast a secret is to reveal or make it public.

clue.text: Fool invested in Creole cooking pot

indicators.note: invested means put inside, so the fool goes into the other letters
cooking means being cooked up or altered, so the word is rearranged

parts.note: an ass is a fool

explanation.surface: An idiot puts money into Creole cuisine and its pot.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cooking' looks part of 'cooking pot' but rearranges CREOLE to CEROLE, into which the ass goes.
explanation.definitionFit: A casserole is a lidded dish in which food is cooked slowly in the oven.

clue.text: One's owed money from councillor and journalist

parts.note: an editor is a senior journalist

explanation.surface: A local politician and a newspaper man both claim they are due cash.
explanation.definitionFit: A person or company to whom a debt is owed is the lender in the arrangement.

clue.text: Condiments made from French wine and grapes fermented without phosphorus

parts.note: vin is French for wine

indicators.note: fermenting changes grapes, so the letters are worked into a new order
signals the phosphorus letter is left out

parts.note: P is the chemical symbol for phosphorus

explanation.surface: Sharp table sauces brewed from French wine and fermenting grapes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' drops P from GRAPES, and 'fermented' turns GRAES into EGARS.
explanation.definitionFit: Acidic liquids such as malt or wine varieties used as seasonings and dressings.

clue.text: Blood line?

parts.note: a blood channel such as a vein is a blood ..., and a shipping line is made up of ships

explanation.walkthrough: 'Blood line' suggests ancestry, but read it as a tube carrying blood, and the shipping line hints at a ship too.
explanation.definitionFit: A vein or artery is a tube in the body carrying blood, and a ship is also so called.

clue.text: A quiet drive, and a place for contemplation

parts.note: sh is a call for quiet
to ram is to drive forcefully

explanation.surface: A calm drive in the country makes an ideal spot for reflection.
explanation.definitionFit: A hermitage or religious retreat in India where people meditate.

clue.text: Special man having strength to cross river twice

indicators.note: the strength word straddles the rivers, holding them inside

parts.note: might is strength

indicators.note: twice means the river letter appears two times

explanation.surface: A strongman bold enough to swim across two rivers.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: the ideal partner a person hopes to marry is the one special man.

clue.text: Reserve time to visit coast

indicators.note: visiting means going in, so the time letter goes inside

parts.note: the seaside is the coast

explanation.surface: Keeping some time free for a trip to the beach.
explanation.definitionFit: Phrasal verb synonym: to keep something back for later use.

clue.text: Transport mainly carrying American food

indicators.note: the shortened transport word carries the American inside it
mainly means most of a word, so its last letter goes

parts.note: to ship is to transport

explanation.surface: A freighter laden with American provisions.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Transport' looks like a noun for vehicles, but it is the verb meaning to send by sea; 'mainly' then trims off its final letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a Japanese dish of vinegared rice with raw fish.

clue.text: Restore salesman's demeanour?

parts.note: a rep is a sales representative
an air is a manner or demeanour

explanation.surface: Bringing back a salesperson's old confident bearing.
explanation.definitionFit: Verb synonym: to fix or mend something back to working condition.

clue.text: Mature, about 49, and able to move quickly

indicators.note: about means around, so the mature word goes around the number

parts.note: to age is to mature
IL is 49 in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: A spry forty-nine-year-old who is still nimble.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: nimble or lithe, quick and light on one's feet.

clue.text: An ineffective person — or Mayfair politician

parts.note: Mayfair, a smart London district, has the postcode W1, with the 1 read as I
MP is a Member of Parliament

explanation.surface: A weak character, or perhaps a Member for a posh part of London.
explanation.walkthrough: Mayfair is in London's W1 postal district; the figure 1 stands in for the letter I.
explanation.definitionFit: Informal synonym: a feeble, timid person lacking strength or courage.

clue.text: All square in topless form of rugby?

indicators.note: topless means without its top, so the first letter goes

parts.note: sevens is rugby played with seven players a side

explanation.surface: A tied score in a game of rugby played without shirts.
explanation.walkthrough: Rugby sevens is a short, seven-a-side version of rugby union.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: a level score or equal position, as in betting at even odds.

clue.text: Fitting engaged sign on back only, initially

indicators.note: on means placed after, so the ring follows the rest

parts.note: the tail is the back end of something

indicators.note: initially means the first letter of the next word is used

parts.note: an engagement ring is the sign that someone is engaged

explanation.surface: A newly engaged person flashes the ring only from behind.
explanation.definitionFit: Noun synonym: the making and adjusting of clothes to fit a customer.

clue.text: Changing printer seems to give a false impression

indicators.note: changing signals the letters are altered into a new order

explanation.surface: Swapping printers appears to leave a misleading result.
explanation.definitionFit: Verb synonym: to misrepresent is to portray something falsely or misleadingly.
